title: Check AGV state, command vitals, and active AGV/system errors on Get AGV Status (HMI/API-backed)
summary: Use the Get AGV Status view (RMS / fleet status UI) to confirm the current AGV state, current command vitals (described as “teal vitals”), and whether the HMI error alert flag is set to true and bubbles to the top when an AGV error or system error is active.
when_to_use: Use when you need to verify whether any AGV errors or system errors are currently active and are being surfaced by the Get AGV Status HMI error alert behavior (alert becomes true and bubbles to the top).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the live check on the RMS / fleet status UI Get AGV Status view and confirm the error alert behavior matches the observed active error condition.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (Get AGV Status view)

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (Get AGV Status view)
system_preconditions: Get AGV Status view is available and populated with AGV state, command vitals, AGV errors, and system errors.

visual_references.description: Frame showing Get AGV status content: current AGV state, current command vitals (“teal vitals”), and sections for AGV errors and system errors; includes the described error alert behavior.

steps.title: Open Get AGV Status view and locate AGV state, teal command vitals, and error sections
steps.purpose: Establish the live screen context needed to verify AGV state, command vitals, and whether errors are being surfaced.
steps.instruction: Open the live Get AGV Status view/screen in the RMS / fleet status UI that shows: (1) AGV state, (2) current command vitals (described as “teal vitals”), and (3) sections for AGV errors and system errors.
steps.expected_result: The Get AGV Status screen displays AGV state, current command vitals (“teal vitals”), and areas where AGV errors and system errors are shown.
steps.healthy_condition: For the AGV(s) shown, the screen is populated with AGV state and teal vitals, and the AGV errors/system errors sections are present for evaluation.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not show the AGV state/teal vitals/error sections needed to evaluate the error alert behavior.

actions.label: Open Get AGV Status
actions.exact_action: Open the live Get AGV Status view/screen that shows AGV state, current command vitals, AGV errors, and system errors.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows the current state of Agvs, its current command vitals, any AGV errors and system errors; pulls from robotics database content and the system faults table (active faults) for the HMI to populate it.

steps.title: Verify displayed AGV state and current command vitals (teal vitals) for a selected AGV entry
steps.purpose: Confirm the screen is correctly presenting the AGV’s state and current command vitals for the AGV(s) under investigation.
steps.instruction: Select an AGV row/entry on the Get AGV Status screen and verify the displayed AGV state and the current command vitals (described as “teal vitals”).
steps.expected_result: For the selected AGV entry, the AGV state and teal vitals are populated and visible on the Get AGV Status screen.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV state and teal vitals are present for the selected AGV entry.
steps.failure_condition: AGV state and/or teal vitals are missing or not populated for the selected AGV entry.

actions.label: Select AGV entry and check vitals
actions.exact_action: For a selected AGV row/entry, verify the displayed AGV state and the current command vitals (the source describes “teal vitals”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows the current state of Agvs and its current command vitals (see teal vitals).

steps.title: Check error alert flag behavior (must be true and bubble to the top when an error exists)
steps.purpose: Validate the HMI error alert behavior that indicates whether system/AGV errors are active.
steps.instruction: On the Get AGV Status screen, check whether an error alert is present and whether it is set to true when there is an error (system error or “geek error”). Confirm that the alert bubbles to the top in the HMI when errors exist.
steps.expected_result: When an AGV error or system error exists, the error alert flag is set to true and bubbles to the top in the HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: With an active error condition, the error alert changes to true and appears at the top (bubbles up).
steps.failure_condition: An active AGV/system error condition is observed, but the error alert is not set to true and/or does not bubble to the top as described.

actions.label: Verify error alert flag and bubble-to-top behavior
actions.exact_action: Check whether an error alert is present and whether it is set to true when there is an error (system error or “geek error”); confirm it bubbles to the top in the HMI.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the screen shows no error alert (not true) while an operator/support observes an active AGV/system error condition.
Stop and escalate if the error alert does not bubble to the top in the HMI despite an observed AGV/system error.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Error alert behavior: if there's an error (system or “geek error”), the alert is changed to true so it pops up and bubbles to the top in the HMI.

steps.title: Confirm AGV errors and/or system errors sections are populated when the alert indicates an error
steps.purpose: Corroborate that the error alert corresponds to populated AGV errors and/or system errors content on the screen.
steps.instruction: If the error alert indicates an error, confirm the Get AGV Status screen is showing AGV errors and/or system errors (described as being populated from the system faults table / active faults).
steps.expected_result: When the error alert indicates an error, the AGV errors and/or system errors sections on the Get AGV Status screen are populated.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV errors and/or system errors lists/fields contain entries consistent with the active error condition.
steps.failure_condition: The error alert indicates an error, but the AGV errors and system errors sections are not populated as expected.

actions.label: Check AGV errors/system errors sections
actions.exact_action: If an error is indicated, confirm the screen is showing AGV errors and/or system errors (the source describes both categories being populated from the system faults table / active faults).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status pulls from robotics database content and the system faults table; active faults are used by the HMI to populate the AGV errors/system errors display.

success_criteria: When an AGV error or system error exists, the Get AGV Status HMI error alert flag is set to true and bubbles to the top.
For the selected AGV entry, AGV state and current command vitals (“teal vitals”) are populated.
When the error alert indicates an error, the AGV errors and/or system errors sections are populated.
healthy_conditions: Error alert flag is true and bubbles to the top when an error exists (system error or “geek error”).
AGV state and teal command vitals are populated for the selected AGV entry.
AGV errors and/or system errors sections show entries when an error is indicated.
failure_conditions: Error alert is not set to true while an active AGV/system error condition is observed.
Error alert does not bubble to the top in the HMI despite an observed AGV/system error.
Error alert indicates an error but AGV errors/system errors sections are not populated as expected.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the error alert does not change to true when an error exists, or if it does not bubble to the top in the HMI despite an observed AGV/system error condition.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Get AGV status screen content showing AGV state, teal command vitals, and the AGV errors/system errors areas; includes the described error alert behavior (alert becomes true and bubbles to the top when errors exist).
